chemistry-e1-l1.title: Iimpawu ezahlukeneyo zezinto nempahla · Uphando olusisiseko nemigaqo ephambili
chemistry-e1-l1.concept: Imathiriyeli esetyenziselwa ukwenza izinto ibizwa ngokuba yimpahla. Isinyithi, iplastiki, iglasi nerabha zinezimpawu ezikhethekileyo.

chemistry-e1-l2.concept: Iimpawu ezahlukeneyo zezinto nempahla iphuhlisa ukukwazi ukutolika idatha yovavanyo nokusombulula iingxaki ngokwenza izicelo kubomi bokwenyani.
chemistry-e1-l2.example: Ngokwenza uhlalutyo lwedatha ngobungakanani nohlalutyo lweempazamo, kufikelelwa kwisigqibo sophando lwesayensi.

chemistry-e2-l1.concept: Xa into ixutywa ngokulinganayo nolwelo ize ingabonwa ngakumbi, kuthiwa “iyanyibilika (ukunyibilika)”. Into engenyibilikiyo itshona ezantsi okanye ibhabhe.
chemistry-e2-l1.example: Ityuwa inyibilika emanzini icace, kodwa isanti ayinyibiliki emanzini itshona ezantsi.

chemistry-e1-q1.prompt: Yeyiphi kwezi ndlela zilandelayo edibanisa ngokuchanekileyo “into” enomila othile nomsebenzi othile ne-“ntsebenzo” eyenziwe ngayo?

options.a: isitulo (into) — ukhuni (impahla)

hints: “Into” ligama lento egqityiweyo esiyisebenzisayo, ize “impahla” libe ligama lezinto ezakha into.
Isitulo yinto, ukhuni yimathiriyeli.
chemistry-e1-q1.explanation: Into enomila nomsebenzi ibizwa ngokuthi “into”, ize imathiriyeli esisiseko eyenze into ibizwe ngokuthi “impahla”.

chemistry-e1-q2.prompt: Umgca werabha okanye ibhaluni, xa utsalwa ngamandla uyatyeleka, kodwa xa ukhululwa ubuyela kumila wawo wokuqala. Yintoni igama lale mpawu yempahla?

options.a: ukuqina-ukubuya (ukuguquguquka)

hints: Yimpawu yokuzama ukubuyela kwimo yokuqala.
Cinga ngokuqina okuvakalayo kumgca werabha.
chemistry-e1-q2.explanation: Impawu apho into eguqulwe ngamandla angaphandle ibuyela kumila wayo wokuqala xa amandla elahlekile ibizwa ngokuba “kukuguquguquka”.

chemistry-e1-q3.prompt: Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo yeempawu zempahla ezenza ijazi lemvula nekhosi yokuntywila?

options.a: Ijazi lemvula: ukungangeni kwamanzi (ukungangeni-manzi) / ikhosi yokuntywila: ukubonakala kakuhle
options.b: Ijazi lemvula: ukuqhuba umbane / ikhosi yokuntywila: ukuqhekeka lula
options.c: Ijazi lemvula: ukutsha lula / ikhosi yokuntywila: ubunzima
options.d: Ijazi lemvula: ukufunxa amanzi / ikhosi yokuntywila: ukungabonakali ngaphakathi

hints: Ijazi lemvula akufuneki lingeniswe ngamanzi, ize ikhosi yokuntywila ibe nokubona ngaphambili.
Impawu zempahla zinquma ukusetyenziswa kwayo.
chemistry-e1-q3.explanation: Ijazi lemvula lenziwe ngempahla ethintela amanzi (ivinili/iplastiki) ukuze lingaqoleki, ize ikhosi yokuntywila yenziwe ngeplastiki okanye iglasi ebonakalayo ukuze ube nokubona phantsi kwamanzi.

chemistry-e1-q4.prompt: Yintoni isizathu sezenzululwazi sokuba umzimba wepani okanye ibhodlo yokupheka kwindlu yokupheka wenziwe ngesinyithi, ize isibambo senziwe ngeplastiki okanye ngomthi?

options.a: Kuba isinyithi sidlulisa ubushushu ngokukhawuleza, ize iplastiki nomthi zingabudlulisi kakuhle ubushushu ukuze isandla singatshi

hints: Ukuze ukutya kuphekwe, ubushushu kufuneka bufike ngokukhawuleza ezantsi kwebhodlo.
Isibambo asinakubanjwa xa sishushu.
chemistry-e1-q4.explanation: Isinyithi sinomthamo ophezulu wokuhambisa ubushushu, ngoko sivumela ukupheka ngokukhawuleza, ize iplastiki nomthi zibe ngabaqhubeki abasezantsi bobushushu, ngoko isandla asitshi ngexesha lokupheka.

chemistry-e1-c.prompt: [Uphando olunzulu lokusingqongileyo] Iplastiki ilula, iqinile kwaye ayibolayo, kodwa xa ilahliwe ayibolayo kwindalo amawaka eminyaka kwaye ingcolisa indalo. Yeyiphi indlela echanekileyo yophuhliso lwesayensi yempahla yokusombulula oku?

options.a: Ukuphuhlisa “iplastiki ebolayo” eyenziwe ngesitatshi sombona njl. ebola ngokwendalo ngezilwanyana ezincinci
options.b: Ukulahla zonke iiplastiki elwandle zizinze phantsi
options.d: Ukuguqula zonke izinto zasekhaya zibe ziyasetyenziswa kube kanye kuphela

hints: Yimathiriyeli entsha elungileyo kwindalo ezibolayo ngezilwanyana ezincinci.
Yiteknoloji ye-Biodegradable.
chemistry-e1-c.explanation: Ukunciphisa ungcoliseko, kuphuhliswa iiplastiki zebiology ezenziwe ngezinto zezityalo ezibola zibe ngamanzi nekhabhon diokside ngezilwanyana ezincinci emva kwexesha elithile.

chemistry-e1-q5.prompt: Iinzipho okanye izikere ezenziwe ngentsimbi, ukuba zivezwe emanzini nasemoyeni ixesha elide, ziyatsha zibe bomvu. Yeyiphi indlela echanekileyo yesayensi yempahla yokuthintela oku?

options.a: Ukuzihlambulula ngeoli ngokucekeceke okanye ukuzipeyinta ukuthintela ukudibana komoya namanzi
options.c: Ukuhlamba intsimbi yonke imihla ngamanzi anetyuwa

hints: Ukuze intsimbi ibole (oksidayizeke), kufuneka zombini ioksijini namanzi.
Ukugquma umphezulu kunokuthintela ioksijini namanzi.
chemistry-e1-q5.explanation: Ukubola kwentsimbi kwenzeka ngenxa yokusebenzisana kwe-oksijini namanzi, ngoko ukuthambisa ngeoli, ukupeyinta, okanye ukwenza i-plating kuthintela ukudibana komoya namanzi kwaye intsimbi ayitshi.

chemistry-e2-q1.prompt: Xa kongezwa ipuni yeswekile kwi-beaker equlethe amanzi ashushu yaza yashukunyiswa ngomthi wegalasi, yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo?

options.a: Amaqhekeza eswekile aqhekeka abe mancinci kakhulu aze asasazeke emanzini onke ngokulinganayo angabonwa
options.b: Iswekile iyabila ibe lilitye eliqinileyo ezantsi kwe-beaker
options.c: Iswekile inyuka ngaphezulu kwamanzi ize ibhabhe emoyeni

hints: Khangela into yokunyibilika (ukunyibilika).
Ayacaca, kodwa xa uzama usayinambitha ngathi mnandi.
chemistry-e2-q1.explanation: Xa iswekile inyibilika emanzini, iimolekyuli zeswekile zisasazeka ngokulinganayo phakathi kweemolekyuli zamanzi zize zibe ngamanzi eswekile acacileyo angabonwayo.

chemistry-e2-q2.prompt: Kutheni iswekile inyibilika ngokukhawuleza kakhulu endebeni equlethe amanzi ashushu kuneyo equlethe amanzi abandayo?

options.a: Kuba xa ubushushu buphezulu, ukushukuma kweemolekyuli zamanzi kuyanda kwaye zikhupha amaqhekeza eswekile ngokukhawuleza

hints: Xa ubushushu buphezulu, ukushukuma kweemolekyuli kuyakhawuleza.
Cinga ngexesha ushukumisa ikyubhu yeswekile eti.
chemistry-e2-q2.explanation: Xa ubushushu bamanzi buphezulu, ukushukuma kobushushu kweemolekyuli zamanzi kuyanda, zize ziqabane namaqhekeza eswekile rhoqo nangamandla, ngoko isantya sokunyibilika siyanda.

chemistry-e2-q3.prompt: Xa amanzi anetyuwa namanzi anodaka egalelwa ngokwahlukeneyo kwifunnel enephepha lokuhluza, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo yento eseleyo kwiphepha lokuhluza?

options.a: Amanzi anetyuwa: akukho nto isalayo / amanzi anodaka: amaqhekeza omhlaba ahluzwa kwiphepha
options.b: Amanzi anetyuwa: iqhekeza letyuwa lisalayo / amanzi anodaka: akukho nto isalayo
options.c: Amanzi anetyuwa namanzi anodaka zombini ziyadlula kwiphepha ngokwazo
options.d: Amanzi anetyuwa namanzi anodaka zombini zisala kwiphepha zonke

hints: Iimolekyuli zesisombululo esinyibilike ngokupheleleyo zincinci kakhulu kuneemingxuma yephepha lokuhluza.
Amaqhekeza omhlaba angenyibilikanga ahluzwa liphepha.
chemistry-e2-q3.explanation: Ityuwa inyibilika ngokupheleleyo ize iimolekyuli zayo zibe ncinci kakhulu kuneenkcazo zephepha, ngoko zonke ziyadlula, kodwa amaqhekeza omhlaba awanyibiliki ngoko akakwazi ukudlula kwiimingxuma zephepha aze asale.

chemistry-e2-q4.prompt: Yeyiphi indlela yokutshintsha imeko yezinto nokwahlula esetyenziswa kwi-salt pan ukufumana ityuwa ecocekileyo esiyityayo kumanzi aselwandle?

options.a: Ukuvusa amanzi aselwandle ngelanga nomoya ukuze kuseleke iikristali zetyuwa kuphela
options.b: Ukubilisa amanzi aselwandle ngamandla ukuze enziwe umkhenkce
options.c: Ukufaka umazibuthe emanzini aselwandle ukutsala ityuwa
options.d: Ukuhluza ngesisefo ukukhupha ityuwa kuphela emanzini aselwandle

hints: Amanzi aselwandle asasazwe ngokungekho nzulu kwi-salt pan xa efumana ilanga, ngamanzi kuphela aba ngumphunga ahambe.
Kukwahlula umxube ngokuvunjwa.
chemistry-e2-q4.explanation: Xa amanzi aselwandle exinezelwe kwi-salt pan aze avuke ngelanga nomoya, amanzi kuphela aba ngumphunga wegesi ahambe, kuse kuseleke iikristali zetyuwa ezinyibilikileyo zimhlophe.

chemistry-e2-c.prompt: [Uphando lomgaqo olunzulu] Kukho amanzi anetyuwa anyibilike ngokupheleleyo apho kufakwe ityuwa eyi-10 g kumanzi a-100 g. Ukuba ubunzima bamanzi anetyuwa ephela bulinganiswa ngesikali sombane, buyi g emangaphi?
hints: Nokuba ityuwa inyibilike ingabonwa, ayilahlekanga.
Ukulondolozwa kobunzima: (ubunzima bamanzi) + (ubunzima betyuwa) = ?
chemistry-e2-c.explanation: Xa into inyibilika, amasuntswana esinyibilikisi (ityuwa) asasazeka phakathi kweemolekyuli zamanzi kwaye akalahleki, ngoko ubunzima besisombululo sipheleleyo bugcinwa ngokuchanekileyo kwi-110 g, isiphumo samanzi netyuwa.

chemistry-e2-q5.prompt: Kutheni, nokuba amanzi neoli yokupheka zifakwe kwibhotile enye zaza zashukunyiswa ngamandla, zaphinda zahlukana ngokupheleleyo zibe ngamacandelo amabini xa zishiywa zikhululekile?

options.a: Kuba ioli yokupheka ayixutywa namanzi kwaye ayixinene kunamanzi ngoko ibhabha ngaphezulu

hints: Amanzi ayi-polar ize ioli ibe yi-non-polar ngoko azinyibiliki.
Ioli ilula kunamanzi (ayixinene kangako) ngoko ibhabha ngaphezulu.
chemistry-e2-q5.explanation: Amanzi ayimolekyuli ye-polar, ioli yokupheka ibe yimolekyuli ye-non-polar ngoko azixutywa, kwaye ukuxinana kweoli yokupheka (malunga ne-0.92 g/cm³) kuphantsi kwamanzi (1.0 g/cm³) ngoko ibhabha kumgangatho ongaphezulu.

chemistry-e3-q1.prompt: Yeyiphi imeko yempahla apho imo itshintsha ngokukhululekileyo ngokwesikhongozeli, kodwa umthamo awutshintshi uhlala unjalo?

options.a: Ulwelo

hints: Cinga xa kugalelwa amanzi okanye ubisi kwenye indebe.
Imo ilandela indebe, kodwa umthamo uhlala unjalo.
chemistry-e3-q1.explanation: Ulwelo lunamabophelelo phakathi kweemolekyuli athambileyo kuneesolidi ngoko imo itshintsha lula ngokwesikhongozeli, kodwa umthamo uhlala uqhelekile kuba ukutsalwa phakathi kweemolekyuli kuyagcinwa.

chemistry-e3-q2.prompt: Isirinji enye yazaliswa ngamanzi, enye yazaliswa ngomoya, yaza imilomo yazo yavalwa ngomnwe yaza ipisitoni yatyhalwa ngamandla. Yintoni eyenzekayo?

options.a: Isirinji enomoya ipisitoni iyatyhalelwa ngaphakathi, kodwa eneminzi ayitshintshi kangako
options.b: Isirinji eneminzi ityhalelwa ngaphakathi ngaphezulu kakhulu kunomoya

hints: Iimolekyuli zegesi zikude kakhulu omnye komnye ngoko kukho indawo engenanto eninzi.
Igesi iyatyunyuzeleka kodwa ulwelo kunzima kakhulu ukutyunyuzeleka.
chemistry-e3-q2.explanation: Igesi (umoya) inemigama emikhulu kakhulu phakathi kweemolekyuli ngoko ityunyuzeleka lula xa kufakwa uxinzelelo yaye umthamo uyancipha, kodwa ulwelo (amanzi) iimolekyuli zinqumle ngokusondeleyo ngoko azityunyuzeleki ngokukhawuleza.

chemistry-e3-q3.prompt: Yeyiphi impawu eqhelekileyo yezinto “eziyisolidi” ezibonwa rhoqo ezijikelezileyo?

options.a: Imo nomthamo ziyaqhubeka ziqhelekile nokuba isikhongozeli sitshintshiwe

hints: Khumbula xa umthi okanye ilitye lifakwa kwenye ibhokisi.
Imo ayitshintshi.
chemistry-e3-q3.explanation: Iisolidi zinamasuntswana azakhayo abotshelelwe ngokuqinileyo nangokwemigaqo, ngoko imo nomthamo ziyaqhubeka ziqhelekile ngaphandle kokuba kufakwa amandla angaphandle.

chemistry-e3-q4.prompt: Xa isitshixo sebhotile yeperfyumu sivulwe kwikona yegumbi, emva kwexesha elifutshane unuka ocekeceke wafika nakumntu osecaleni elinye legumbi. Yeyiphi imigaqo yesayensi echaza oku?

options.a: Isikhongozeli seperfyumu sivuthela ngokuzikhulula emoyeni, nto ebizwa “i-diffusion”
options.b: Ulwelo lweperfyumu lwaphola lwahamba lujikeleza phantsi

hints: Amasuntswana ezinto awahleli ngaphandle kokushukuma, ahlala eshukuma ngokuzikhulula.
Ibizwa ngantoni ukusasazeka kwegesi?
chemistry-e3-q4.explanation: Ukuhamba kwamasuntswana eperfyumu ngokuzikhulula nangokungaphezi emoyeni kuyo yonke indlela, asasazeka kwindawo enenkxaso ephezulu aye kwenephantsi, kubizwa “i-diffusion”.

chemistry-e3-c.prompt: [Uvavanyo lokucinga olunzulu] Ngaba umoya ongabonwayo uneentsikelelo (ubunzima) njengesolidi okanye ulwelo? Yeyiphi indlela yovavanyo eyamkelekileyo eyimpumelelo yokuyingqina?

options.a: Ukulinganisa ibhola yebasketball egcwaliswe ngomoya ngesikali sombane esichanekileyo, uze ukhuphe umoya uphinde ulinganise ukujonga umahluko
options.b: Ukuphosa ibhaluni phezulu ukukhangela indlela ebhabhayo
options.c: Ukuvula ibhotile yeglasi engenanto elangeni ukujonga ukuba iyashushuma
options.d: Ukufaka isandla emanzini ukulinganisa ubuqabaqaba bamanzi

hints: Igesi nayo yimpahla ngoko inobunzima.
Fanisa isikali xa umoya ufakiwe kwaye xa ukhutshiwe.
chemistry-e3-c.explanation: Xa ulinganisa ibhola egcwele umoya uze uphinde ulinganise emva kokukhupha umoya, ubunzima buyehla, nto ethi ichaze ukuba umoya njengegesi nawo unobunzima kunye nobunzima bokuxinwa.

chemistry-e3-q5.prompt: Xa “i-dry ice” ebandayo esetyenziswa ngexesha lokupakisha ikhrim ekhenkcezayo ishiywe kubushushu begumbi, ayenzi mathontsi amanzi kwaphela kodwa iguquka ngqo ibe ngumoya ize ilahleke. Yintoni lo tshintsho lwemeko?

options.a: Isolidi iguquka ngqo ibe yigesi ngaphandle kokudlula kulwelo, ibizwa “i-sublimation”
options.d: Igesi iguquka ibe lulwelo, “ukujika kube lulwelo”

hints: I-dry ice yikhabhon diokside eyisolidi.
Kuxinzelelo lwe-1 atm nobushushu begumbi iguquka ngqo ibe yigesi ngaphandle kokudlula kulwelo.
chemistry-e3-q5.explanation: I-dry ice (ikhabhon diokside eyisolidi) ayinakubakho njengolwelo kuxinzelelo olulinganayo (1 atm) ize ibonise ukuguquka ngqo isuka kwisolidi ibe yigesi ebizwa ngokuba “yi-sublimation”.

chemistry-e4-q1.prompt: Ikani yesiselo esibandayo esisandula ukukhutshwa kwisikhenkcezisi yabekwa etafileni ixesha elifutshane yaza kwavela amathontsi amanzi emphezulwini wekani. La mathontsi amanzi avela phi?

options.a: Umphunga wamanzi wegesi osemoyeni udibana nekani ebandayo ujikeleza ube ngamanzi olwelo
options.b: Isiselo siphumele ngaphandle ngokudlula udonga lwe-aluminium lwekani
options.c: Ipeyinta emphezulwini wekani inyibilikile yenza amathontsi
options.d: Umsi wombhalo omhlophe uphuma etafileni yomthi

hints: Emoyeni kusoloko kukho umphunga wamanzi ongabonwayo.
Xa umphunga wamanzi udibana nomphezulu obandayo uyaphola ujike ube ngamathontsi olwelo (condensation).
chemistry-e4-q1.explanation: Umphunga wamanzi wegesi owawusemoyeni udibana nomphezulu obandayo wekani uphulukane nobushushu uguquke ube ngamathontsi amanzi olwelo, nto ebizwa ngokuba “yi-condensation (ukuguquka kube lulwelo)”.

chemistry-e4-q2.prompt: Xa amanzi olwelo ekhenkceza abe ngumkhenkce oyisolidi, yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo yotshintsho lobunzima nomthamo?

options.a: Ubunzima abutshintshi buhlala buyafana, kodwa umthamo uyanda

hints: Nokuba amanzi akhenkceza, inani lilonke leemolekyuli ezenza impahla alitshintshi.
Xa umkhenkce wenziwe, wenza ulwakhiwo lweringi enamacala amathandathu inyusa indawo engenanto.
chemistry-e4-q2.explanation: Xa amanzi ekhenkceza abe ngumkhenkce, ubunzima buyagcinwa, kodwa kuba iimolekyuli zamanzi zenza iikristali zeheksagoni ezinendawo engenanto ngobunye be-hydrogen, umthamo unyuka malunga ne-10%.

chemistry-e4-q3.prompt: Yintoni isizathu esiphambili sezenzululwazi “sokuqhekeka kwemibhobho yamanzi ngenxa yomkhenkce” ebusika xa ubushushu bukwi-zero?

options.a: Amanzi akwimibhobho akhenkceza aze athe tyaba nomthamo uyandiswa uyidibanise ngamandla udonga lombhobho
options.b: Ngenxa yobuqaba, imibhobho yentsimbi ijiya inyibilike
options.c: Uxinzelelo lwamanzi lwenyuka lwaba ngama-10 ngobusika

hints: Cinga ukuba umthamo utshintsha njani xa amanzi eguquka abe ngumkhenkce.
Xa amanzi ekhenkceza, umthamo uyanda.
chemistry-e4-q3.explanation: Amanzi anempawu eyodwa yokwandisa umthamo xa ekhenkceza, ngoko amanzi asemzibhobho ogcwele xa ekhenkceza, uxinzelelo lokwanda luyawonakalisa umbhobho wentsimbi oqinileyo, nto ebizwa ngokuba kukuqhekeka ngenxa yomkhenkce.

chemistry-e4-q4.prompt: Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo yomahluko “wokuvuka” “nokubilisa” xa kubilisiwe amanzi epanini?

options.a: Ukuvuka kwenzeka kuphela emphezulwini wolwelo, kwaye ukubila kwenzeka kwindawo yokubila (100℃) kunye nokwenziwa kweebhabhulu kumphezulu nangaphakathi konke
options.b: Ukuvuka kwenzeka kuphela kwi-100℃, ize ukubila kwenzeke kuzo zonke iindawo zobushushu
options.c: Ukuvuka kukuba amanzi abe ngumkhenkce, ukubila kukuba abe ngumphunga

hints: Ukoma kwempahla yokuhlamba kukuvuka okwenzeka kancinci emphezulwini ngobushushu obuphantsi.
Ukubila kwamanzi ngamandla kwi-100 degrees yimiphunga ephuma ngaphakathi.
chemistry-e4-q4.explanation: Ukuvuka yinto apho iimolekyuli zomphezulu wolwelo ziguquka zibe yigesi ngaphantsi kwendawo yokubila, ize ukubila libe yimeko apho kufikelelwe kwindawo yokubila ize igesi yenziwe ngamandla ingekho kumphezulu kuphela kodwa nangaphakathi konke.

chemistry-e4-c.prompt: [Utshintsho lwemeko olunzulu] Amanzi afakwe kwi-beaker aza ashushu abila ngamandla. Nokuba amandla omlilo anyuswa aze kuqhutywe ukufaka ubushushu, kutheni isikali se-thermometer singasenyuki ngaphezu kwe-100℃?

options.a: Kuba amandla obushushu anikezelwe asetyenziswa konke kwinguquko yemeko (ubushushu bokuguquka-ngumphunga) kunokunyusa ubushushu bamanzi
options.b: Kuba i-thermometer iyaphuka ngaphezulu kwe-100 degrees
options.c: Kuba amanzi akakwazi ukufunxa ubushushu obungakumbi

hints: Ngexesha lokuguquka kwemeko, ubushushu bempahla buhlala bulinganayo.
Oku kubizwa “ngobushushu obufihlakeleyo (latent heat, ubushushu bokuguquka-ngumphunga)”.
chemistry-e4-c.explanation: Ngexesha apho ulwelo olucocekileyo lubila, amandla obushushu afakiweyo aqhawula ukutsalwa phakathi kweemolekyuli aze aguqule kwimeko yegesi (ubushushu bokuguquka-ngumphunga) asetyenziswa konke, ngoko ubushushu buhlala bulinganayo kude kube onke amanzi eguquke abe ngumphunga.

chemistry-e4-q5.prompt: Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo yenkqubo yotshintsho lwemeko ye-“umbethe” ocacileyo ukwiintsimbi zengca ekuseni kakhulu kunye ne-“frost” emhlophe kwiifestile okanye uphahla ebusuku bokuqala kokubusika?

options.a: Umbethe: umphunga wamanzi uguquka ube ngamathontsi olwelo (liquefaction) / frost: umphunga wamanzi uguquka ngqo ube ziikristali zomkhenkce (sublimation)
options.b: Umbethe: umkhenkce uyanyibilika / frost: amanzi ayabila
options.c: Umbethe kunye ne-frost zombini ngamanzi avuke abe ngumphunga
options.d: Umbethe: amanzi omthombo avela emhlabeni / frost: ikhephu elisuka esibhakabhakeni

hints: Umbethe ngamathontsi amanzi olwelo (umphunga → ulwelo).
I-frost yikristali zomkhenkce ezenziwa kubushushu obungezantsi ku-zero (umphunga → isolidi).
chemistry-e4-q5.explanation: Umbethe ngumphunga wamanzi osemoyeni odibene (uguquka ube lulwelo) emphezulwini wengca ebandayo ebusuku, ize i-frost ibe ngumphunga ovela kubushushu obungezantsi kwe-zero uguquke ngqo ube ziikristali zomkhenkce ngaphandle kokudlula kulwelo.

chemistry-e5-q1.prompt: Iswekile eyi-50 g yafakwa kumanzi a-200 g yaza yanyibilika ngokupheleleyo. Kula manzi eswekile, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ye-“solvent”, “solute” ne-“solution”?

options.a: Solvent: amanzi / solute: iswekile / solution: amanzi eswekile
options.b: Solvent: iswekile / solute: amanzi / solution: amanzi eswekile
options.c: Solvent: amanzi eswekile / solute: iswekile / solution: amanzi
options.d: Solvent: amanzi / solute: amanzi eswekile / solution: iswekile

hints: Ulwelo olunyibilikisayo = solvent, into enyibilikayo = solute, umxube ogqityiweyo = solution.
Kwamanzi eswekile, iswekile enyibilikayo yisolute, amanzi anyibilikisayo yisolvent.
chemistry-e5-q1.explanation: Amanzi, impahla enyibilikisayo, “yisolvent”, iswekile enyibilikayo “yisolute”, ize umxube ocacileyo ophuma ekuxutyweni kwazo ngokulinganayo ubizwe ngokuthi “isolution”.

chemistry-e5-q2.prompt: Sifuna ukuphanda iimpawu zesisombululo setyuwa esikwi-beaker. Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo yempawu yesisombululo, umxube ofanayo?

options.a: Nokuba uthatha isampulu kwindawo ephezulu, ephakathi okanye ephantsi yesisombululo, ubusi betyuwa (ukuxinana) buyafana ngokupheleleyo
options.b: Ixesha lingaphambili, ityuwa iyatshona ngokwayo ngenxa yobunzima
options.c: Ngokujonga ngeglasi yokukhulisa, amaqhekeza etyuwa abonakala ebhabha emanzini
options.d: Ngokuhluza ngephepha lokuhluza, yonke ityuwa ihluzwa kwiphepha

hints: Isisombululo ngumxube “ofanayo” oxutywe ngokulinganayo kwinqanaba leemolekyuli.
Nokuba ushiywe ixesha elide, aluchwethi.
chemistry-e5-q2.explanation: Isisombululo esiyinyani (umxube ofanayo) sinamasuntswana esolute asasazeke ngokulinganayo phakathi kweemolekyuli zesolvent, ngoko nokuba sishiywe ixesha elide asityi aze ukuxinana kuyafana kuzo zonke iindawo.

chemistry-e5-q3.prompt: Xa kufakwa ityuwa kumanzi a-100 g, kutheni ityuwa inyibilika ngakumbi xa amanzi ekubushushu be-60℃ kuneyo ye-20℃?

options.a: Kuba xa ubushushu buphezulu, ukushukuma kobushushu kweemolekyuli zesolvent kuyanda kwaye ukunyibilika kwesolute kuyanda
options.b: Kuba xa ubushushu buphezulu, ulwakhiwo lweemolekyuli zetyuwa luyatshabalala

hints: Khumbula ijika lotshintsho lokunyibilika ngobushushu.
Okuthe ukushushuma, ukushukuma kweemolekyuli zempahla kuyanda.

chemistry-e5-q4.prompt: I-tomato encinci yafakwa kwisitanki samanzi amsulwa yaza yatshona ezantsi. Xa kwafakwa ityuwa eninzi kwesi sitanki kwaza kushukunyiswa, i-tomato yabhabha ngaphezulu emanzini. Yintoni isizathu?

options.a: Kuba ityuwa inyibilike yenza ukuxinana kwesisombululo setyuwa kube kukhulu kunokuxinana kwetomato
options.b: Kuba ityuwa yatya itomato yayenza yalula

hints: Xa ukuxinana kolwelo kukhulu kunokwento, into iyabhabha.
Kokukhulu ityuwa enyibilikayo, ngokukhulu ubunzima (ukuxinana) bolwelo.
chemistry-e5-q4.explanation: Amanzi anetyuwa anokuxinana okukhulu kunamanzi amsulwa, ize xa ityuwa iqhubeka ninyibilika ukuxinana kwamanzi anetyuwa kube kukhulu kunokuxinana okuphakathi kwetomato, amandla okubhabha abe makhulu kunamandla omxhuzulane aze ibhabhe ngaphezulu.

chemistry-e5-c.prompt: [Ukwenziwa kweekristali okunzulu] Kwenziwa isisombululo esigcweleyo se-alum enyibilike kumanzi ashushu e-60℃ de kwayeka ukunyibilika, yaza intsontelo yeselika yaxhonywa kwesi sisombululo yaza yapholiswa kancinci kubushushu begumbi, yaza kwakhula iikristali ezintle ze-alum ezikhazimlayo ezifana namatye azizityebi kwintsontelo. Yintoni umgaqo walo mkhwa?

options.a: Kuba xa ubushushu buyehla, ukunyibilika kwe-alum kuyancipha, ngoko isixa esingasenakuhlala sinyibilikile sixinwa njengeekristali eziyisolidi
options.b: Kuba isisombululo se-alum sikhenkcezile saba ngumkhenkce
options.c: Kuba intsontelo yeselika yenze i-alum ngokwekhemikhali
options.d: Kuba uthuli emoyeni luguquke lwaba yi-alum

Xa ubushushu buyehla kwaye ukunyibilika kuncipha, iyaphuma (ukuxinwa).
chemistry-e5-c.explanation: Xa ubushushu buyehla, ukunyibilika kwesolidi kuyancipha ngokukhawuleza, ngoko isolute egqithisileyo eyayinyibilike ngaphezu kokunyibilika okuncitshisiweyo iyadibana yenze iikristali ezi-regular iphume, nto ebizwa ngokuba “yi-recrystallization (precipitation)”.

chemistry-e5-q5.prompt: Yintoni umgaqo wesayensi wokuba xa kuvulwa isivalo sekani esibandayo yesiselo esinegesi (isayida, ikola) kuvakala isandi “tsh” kwaye kuvuka iibhabhulu ngamandla ngaphakathi kwesiselo?

options.a: Xa ikani ivulwa uxinzelelo lwangaphakathi luyehla lufikelele kuxinzelelo lomoya, ize ukunyibilika kwegesi yekhabhon diokside kuyehle ngokukhawuleza
options.b: Xa ikani ivulwa ubushushu besiselo buyehla ngokukhawuleza bube ngaphantsi kwe-zero

hints: Cinga ngomthetho kaHenry (Henry's law).
Ukunyibilika kwegesi kuyanda xa uxinzelelo luphezulu, kwaye kuyancipha xa uxinzelelo luyehla.
chemistry-e5-q5.explanation: Igesi yekhabhon diokside eyayinyibilike kakhulu emanzini ngenxa yoxinzelelo oluphezulu ngaphakathi kwekani evaliweyo, xa isivalo sivuliwe uxinzelelo luyehla, ngokomthetho kaHenry ukunyibilika kuyancipha ize iphume ngohlobo lweebhabhulu.

chemistry-e6-q1.prompt: Xa kwaphoswa izisombululo ezahlukeneyo kwi-indicator yekhaphetshu ebomvu, isisombululo A saguquka sabomvu, ize isisombululo B saguquka sabaluhlaza sidlula sibe luhlaza kwaza kwaba mthubi. Yeyiphi impawu echanekileyo yezi zisombululo zombini?

options.a: Isisombululo A sine-asidi, isisombululo B sine-alkali (base)
options.b: Isisombululo A sine-alkali, isisombululo B sine-asidi
options.c: Izisombululo A no B zombini azinabuso (neutral)
options.d: Isisombululo A asinabuso, isisombululo B sine-asidi

hints: Ijusi yekhaphetshu ebomvu, i-indicator yendalo, iqulethe umbala we-anthocyanin.
Kwi-asidi iguquka ibe bomvu, kwi-alkali ibe luhlaza ukuya kumthubi.
chemistry-e6-q1.explanation: I-indicator yekhaphetshu ebomvu iguquka ibe bomvu kwizisombululo ezine-asidi, ize kwizisombululo ze-alkali iguquke ibe luhlaza, luhlaza okotyheli, okanye mthubi.

chemistry-e6-q2.prompt: Xa kwatshiswa i-asidi ye-hydrochloric ehlanjululweyo okanye iviniga kumaqokobhe amaqanda okanye iqhekeza lemabhile (equlethe i-calcium carbonate), kwavela iibhabhulu ezininzi. Yintoni utshintsho olwenzekayo xa le gesi iqokelelwa idluliswe kumanzi ekalika?

options.a: Amanzi ekalika ayaluphuka abe mhlophe (kuqinisekiswa igesi yekhabhon diokside)
options.b: Xa kufakwa umlilo emanzini ekalika, atsha ngesandi esikhulu
options.c: Umbala wamanzi ekalika uguquka ube luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka

hints: Xa i-carbonate ne-asidi zisabela, kuvelisa igesi yekhabhon diokside (CO₂).
Xa i-CO₂ idluliswa emanzini ekalika, ivelisa i-calcium carbonate ephuphumayo emhlophe.
chemistry-e6-q2.explanation: Xa i-calcium carbonate ($\text{CaCO}_3$) isabela nge-asidi, kuvela igesi yekhabhon diokside ($\text{CO}_2$), ize ikhabhon diokside isabele namanzi ekalika ($\text{Ca(OH)}_2$) yenze ukuphuphuma kwe-calcium carbonate emhlophe nokwenza amanzi aluphuke.

chemistry-e6-q3.prompt: Yintoni umgaqo wesayensi wobulumko bemihla ngemihla wokufafaza ijusi yelemon okanye iviniga ukususa ivumba lentlanzi (i-trimethylamine njl. ine-basicity) ngexesha lokupheka intlanzi?

options.a: Kuba into ene-asidi (ijusi yelemon) idibana nento ye-alkali enevumba lentlanzi yenze impendulo yokuthomalalisa (neutralization)
options.b: Kuba ijusi yelemon ikhenkcisa inyama yentlanzi
options.c: Kuba iviniga inyibilikisa ikalsiyam yamathambo entlanzi
options.d: Kuba umbala ophuzi welemon ugquma ivumba

hints: Xa i-asidi ne-base zidibana zilahlekelwa yimpawu zazo, kwenzeka “impendulo yokuthomalalisa”.
Isithako sevumba lentlanzi sine-alkali.
chemistry-e6-q3.explanation: I-amines, ezizizinto ezibangela ivumba lentlanzi, zine-alkali, ngoko ukufafaza ijusi yelemon (i-citric acid) okanye iviniga (i-acetic acid) kubangela impendulo yokuthomalalisa phakathi kwe-asidi ne-base ize ivumba lentlanzi lisuswe.

chemistry-e6-q4.prompt: Xa kuphelisiwa umlilo emva kokubasa imililo ekampini, ukugquma ngomhlaba okanye ngesanti okanye ukufafaza i-fire extinguisher kuthintela esiphi kwezi ntlanu zokutsha?

options.a: Ukuthintela ukuhanjiswa kwe-oksijini yomoya (ukucima ngokuthintela umoya)

hints: Izinto ezintathu zokutsha: into etshayo, ioksijini, ubushushu obungaphezulu kwendawo yokutsha.
Ukugquma ngesanti kuthintela umoya ukudlula emlilweni.
chemistry-e6-q4.explanation: Ukugquma ngesanti okanye ngengubo eqinileyo okanye ukufafaza i-fire extinguisher yekhabhon diokside kuthintela ngokupheleleyo ukungena kwe-oksijini ize ibe yindlela “yokucima ngokuthintela umoya”.

chemistry-e6-c.prompt: [Ukuqiqa impendulo okunzulu] Kwi-solution ye-sodium hydroxide eguqula iphepha le-litmus elibomvu laba luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, kwatshiswa kancinci i-hydrochloric acid ehlanjululweyo ngepipette ngokuxutywa. Yeyiphi inguquko echanekileyo kumxube xa kufakwe i-hydrochloric acid eyaneleyo?

options.a: Ubushushu buyavela kwaye buyanda, ize isisombululo sokugqibela siguqule iphepha le-litmus eliluhlaza lube bomvu
options.b: Isisombululo siphola ngokukhawuleza siguquke sibe ngumkhenkce
options.c: Akukho mpendulo yenzekayo kwaye ihlala injalo

hints: Kwimpendulo yokuthomalalisa, ubushushu bokuthomalalisa buyavela kwaye ubushushu buyanda.
Xa i-hydrochloric acid ifakwe ngokugqithisileyo, kuba sisisombululo se-asidi.
chemistry-e6-c.explanation: Xa i-asidi (i-hydrochloric acid) ne-base (i-sodium hydroxide) zisabela, kuvela amanzi nelayi, ubushushu bokuthomalalisa buyakhutshwa ize ubushushu bunyuke. Xa i-hydrochloric acid ifakwe ngokugqithisileyo, isisombululo sonke siba nge-asidi siguqule iphepha le-litmus eliluhlaza libe bomvu.

chemistry-e6-q5.prompt: Xa umlilo omkhulu wesigxina usasazeka, ukwenza “umgca womlilo (firebreak)” ngokugawula kwangaphambili imithi esendleleni yomlilo ngesaha yombane kususa esiphi kwezi ntlanu zokutsha?

options.a: Ukususa into etshayo (amafutha)
options.c: Ukunciphisa ubushushu bube ngaphantsi kwendawo yokutsha

hints: Ukuze umlilo utshe, into etshayo kufuneka ihlale iqhubeka.
Ukuba imithi isusiwe kwangaphambili, umlilo awusenayo indawo yokutshabalala.
chemistry-e6-q5.explanation: Kukususa kwangaphambili “into etshayo” enye yezinto eziyimfuneko zokutsha, ngokususa amafutha anokutsha endleleni yomlilo ukuthintela ukusasazeka komlilo wesigxina, ngumgaqo wokucima ngokususa.

chemistry-m1-q1.prompt: Yintoni isizathu esiphambili “soxinzelelo lwegesi” esivakala emgangathweni wesikhongozeli esivaliweyo esiqulethe igesi?

options.a: Inani elikhulu lamasuntswana egesi ashukuma ngokuzikhulula ahlala eqhaqhazela eludongeni lwesikhongozeli
options.b: Amasuntswana egesi atshona ezantsi kuphela ngenxa yomxhuzulane woMhlaba
options.c: Amasuntswana egesi atsalana ngombane othe cwaka
options.d: Amasuntswana egesi azama ukunyibilikisa iindonga zesikhongozeli

hints: Iimolekyuli zegesi ziqhuba ngesantya esikhulu kakhulu.
Inani namandla okuqhaqhazela eludongeni adala uxinzelelo.
chemistry-m1-q1.explanation: Uxinzelelo lwegesi luvela emandleni kwiyunithi yendawo awenziwa ngamasuntswana egesi aqhaqhazela ngokungaphezi nangokungalungelelananga eludongeni lwangaphakathi lwesikhongozeli.

chemistry-m1-q2.prompt: Kubushushu obungatshintshiyo, uxinzelelo lwegesi enomthamo we-60 mL kwi-1 atm lwenyuswa lwaya ku-3 atm. Ngokomthetho kaBoyle, umthamo wale gesi ungakanani?

options.a: 20 mL

hints: Umthetho kaBoyle: P₁V₁ = P₂V₂
1 atm × 60 mL = 3 atm × (?) mL
chemistry-m1-q2.explanation: Ngokomthetho kaBoyle, xa ubushushu bungatshintshanga, $P_1 V_1 = P_2 V_2$ iyasebenza. $1\text{ atm} \times 60\text{ mL} = 3\text{ atm} \times V_2 \implies V_2 = 20\text{ mL}$.

chemistry-m1-q3.prompt: Xa ibhegi yamaqebengwana yaphathwa yaya entabeni ephakamileyo, ibhegi yamaqebengwana yaqina yatyhefa ngokungathi iza kuqhuma. Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo ngolwalamano loxinzelelo nomthamo wegesi?

options.a: Ngokuya phezulu entabeni uxinzelelo lomoya (uxinzelelo lwangaphandle) luyehla, ngoko umthamo wegesi ngaphakathi kwebhegi uyandiswa
options.b: Ubushushu entabeni buphezulu kakhulu ngoko igesi yandile

hints: Xa ukuphakama kunyuka umoya uyancipha ize uxinzelelo lomoya luyehle.
Xa uxinzelelo lwangaphandle luncipha, umthamo wegesi uyanda (umthetho kaBoyle).
chemistry-m1-q3.explanation: Xa ukuphakama kunyuka, uxinzelelo lomoya luyehla. Ngenxa yokuba uxinzelelo lwegesi ngaphakathi kwebhegi lukhulu kunoxinzelelo lomoya wangaphandle, umthamo wegesi yangaphakathi uyandiswa de uxinzelelo lwangaphakathi nolwangaphandle lulingane.

chemistry-m1-q4.prompt: I-ping-pong ebhityileyo yafakwa emanzini ashushu yaza yabuyela kwimo ejikelezileyo neqinileyo. Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo ngomthetho kaCharles nemodeli yamasuntswana egesi?

options.a: Ubushushu bunyuke ize ukushukuma kwamasuntswana egesi ngaphakathi kwebhola kwande, inani namandla okuqhaqhazela kwande ize umthamo wandiswe
options.c: Amanzi ashushu angene ngaphakathi kwebhola ayigcwalisa
options.d: Ubushushu bunyukile ize inani leemolekyuli zegesi ngaphakathi kwebhola lahlukana laba kabini

hints: Umthetho kaCharles: xa uxinzelelo lungatshintshanga, xa ubushushu bunyuka umthamo wegesi uyandiswa.
Xa ubushushu bunyuka, isantya esiphakathi samasuntswana egesi siyanda.
chemistry-m1-q4.explanation: Ngokomthetho kaCharles, xa ubushushu bunyuka, amandla okushukuma aphakathi eemolekyuli zegesi ayanda, ukuqhaqhazela eludongeni lwangaphakathi kuqina, ngoko uxinzelelo lwangaphakathi luyanda yaza ibhola ebhityileyo ibuyele kwimo yayo.

chemistry-m1-c.prompt: [Isantya sokusasazeka esinzulu] Kumacala omabini ombhobho omde weglasi kwafakwa ukotini ofakwe kwi-ammonia egxininisiweyo (ubunzima beemolekyuli 17) nokotini ofakwe kwi-hydrochloric acid egxininisiweyo (ubunzima beemolekyuli 36.5) ngaxeshanye, yaza yavalwa ngezivalo zerabha. Emva kwexesha elifutshane kwavela ibhanti lomsi omhlophe (i-ammonium chloride) ngaphakathi kombhobho, ngaphakathi kwendawo eyiphi ekwi-ammonia okanye ekwi-hydrochloric acid ebinakuyimeli ngakumbi?

options.a: Indawo esondele kakhulu kukotini ofakwe kwi-hydrochloric acid
options.b: Indawo esondele kakhulu kukotini ofakwe kwi-ammonia

hints: Nangakumbi iimolekyuli zegesi ezilula, ngokukhawuleza ukusasazeka (umthetho kaGraham wokusasazeka).
I-ammonia (17) ilula kakhulu kune-hydrogen chloride (36.5).
chemistry-m1-c.explanation: Isantya sokusasazeka kwegesi singqamene ngokungeyomfuneko nengcambu yesikwere yobunzima beemolekyuli. Igesi ye-ammonia elula, enobunzima beemolekyuli be-17, ihamba ngokukhawuleza kakhulu kunegesi ye-hydrogen chloride enzima (36.5), ngoko impendulo yenzeka kwindawo esondele kokotini we-hydrochloric acid ohamba kancinci ukwenza ibhanti lomsi omhlophe.

chemistry-m1-q5.prompt: Ibhaluni yerabha eqinileyo eyayizaliswe ngumoya yafakwa kwi-nitrogen engamanzi ye-minus 196℃ yaza yaphulukana nomthamo wayo ngokuphantse ngokupheleleyo yanciphisa yaba flat. Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo?

options.a: Kubushushu obuphantsi kakhulu amandla okushukuma kweemolekyuli zegesi ngaphakathi kwebhaluni abe buthathaka kakhulu ize umgama phakathi kweemolekyuli ube mncinci
options.b: Irabha yebhaluni ivumele igesi yonke idlule ngaphandle

hints: Umthetho kaCharles: umthamo wegesi ungqamene nobushushu obupheleleyo.
Xa ubushushu buphantsi kakhulu, ukushukuma kweemolekyuli zegesi kuyacotha kwangathi kuyema.
chemistry-m1-q5.explanation: Ngokomthetho kaCharles, xa ubushushu buphola ngokukhawuleza bufikelele ngaphantsi kwe-zero $196^\circ\text{C}$, ukushukuma kobushushu kweemolekyuli zegesi kuyacotha kakhulu ize inxalenye yazo ibe lulwelo, ngoko umthamo wangaphakathi uncipha ngokubonakalayo.

chemistry-m2-q1.prompt: Yintoni isizathu esiphambili sokuba i-athomu eyakhiwe ngenyukliyasi ne-electrons ibe nesimo sokungathathi cala ngokombane?

options.a: Kuba intlawulo (+) yenyukliyasi nentlawulo (-) epheleleyo yee-electrons ezijikeleza inyukliyasi zilingana ngobukhulu
options.d: Kuba i-athomu incinci kakhulu ukuba ibe nombane

hints: Inyukliyasi inentlawulo (+) ngenxa yee-protons.
Ii-electrons zine-intlawulo (-).
chemistry-m2-q1.explanation: I-athomu ayithathi cala ngokombane kuba intlawulo epheleleyo (+) yee-protons zenyukliyasi esembindini nentlawulo epheleleyo (-) yee-electrons ezijikeleza ngeorbits zilingana ngokupheleleyo ngobukhulu.

chemistry-m2-q2.prompt: Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo ngokwakhiwa kwee-“ion”, apho i-athomu engathathi cala ilahlekelwa okanye ifumana ii-electrons yaze ibe nentlawulo?

options.a: Ii-athomu zesinyithi zilahlekelwa ii-electrons zibe ngama-ion aqinisekileyo (+), ize ii-athomu ezingezizo izinyithi zifumane ii-electrons zibe ngama-ion angalunganga (-)
options.b: Ii-protons zenyukliyasi ziqhuma ngaphandle zibe yi-anion
options.d: Nokuba i-athomu iba yi-ion, inani lilonke lee-electrons alitshintshi

hints: I-sodium (Na) ilahlekelwa yi-electron enye ibe yi-Na⁺.
I-chlorine (Cl) ifumana i-electron enye ibe yi-Cl⁻.
chemistry-m2-q2.explanation: I-athomu ilahlekelwa ii-electrons zeqokobhe elingaphandle ibe yi-cation (ubukhulu izinyithi), okanye ifumane ii-electrons yenze i-anion eyanelisayo umgaqo we-octet (ubukhulu ii-athomu ezingezizo izinyithi).

chemistry-m2-q3.prompt: Isampulu engaziwayo A neB zafakwa kwilangatye langaphandle, isampulu A yabonisa ilangatye eliphuzi, isampulu B yabonisa ilangatye eliluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka okuluhlaza. Zeziphi izinto zesinyithi eziqulethwe kwiisampulu A neB ngokwahlukeneyo?

options.a: Isampulu A: i-sodium (Na) / isampulu B: ubhedu (Cu)
options.b: Isampulu A: i-potassium (K) / isampulu B: i-strontium (Sr)
options.c: Isampulu A: ubhedu (Cu) / isampulu B: i-lithium (Li)
options.d: Isampulu A: i-barium (Ba) / isampulu B: i-sodium (Na)

hints: Umbala welangatye le-sodium etyuweni ophuzi okhazimlayo.
Ubhedu bubonisa ilangatye eliluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka okuluhlaza.
chemistry-m2-q3.explanation: Into ethile yesinyithi ibonisa umbala wayo ongahlukanga welangatye. I-sodium ($\text{Na}$) inelangatye eliphuzi, ubhedu ($\text{Cu}$) bunelangatye eliluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka okuluhlaza.

chemistry-m2-q4.prompt: Ukujonga ukuba ii-ion zechloride (Cl⁻) ezisalela njengemveliso yokubulala iintsholongwane emanzini epompo ziyabakho, yeyiphi i-reagent ekufuneka itshiswe, kunye nefomula yechemikhali ye-precipitate emhlophe evelayo?

options.a: Isisombululo se-silver nitrate (AgNO₃) — i-silver chloride (AgCl)

hints: Xa i-silver ion (Ag⁺) ne-chloride ion (Cl⁻) zidibana, kuvela i-precipitate emhlophe engananyibilikiyo emanzini.
Umlinganiso wokwenziwa kwe-precipitate: Ag⁺ + Cl⁻ → AgCl↓
chemistry-m2-q4.explanation: Xa i-silver ion ($\text{Ag}^+$) yesisombululo se-silver nitrate ne-chloride ion ($\text{Cl}^-$) emanzini zisabela, zenza i-precipitate emhlophe ye-silver chloride ($\text{AgCl}$) engananyibilikiyo emanzini, ngoko i-chloride ion inokufunyanwa.

chemistry-m2-c.prompt: [Uhlalutyo olunzulu lwee-ion] Sifuna ukujonga ukuba amanzi onakeleyo evela efektri aqulethe ii-ion zeplumbum (Pb²⁺) na. Yeyiphi imibala nefomula echanekileyo ye-precipitate evela xa kutshiswa isisombululo se-potassium iodide (KI)?

options.a: I-precipitate etyheli — i-lead iodide (PbI₂)

hints: Xa i-lead ion ne-iodide ion zidibana, kuvela i-precipitate etyheli ecacileyo.
Pb²⁺ + 2I⁻ → PbI₂↓
chemistry-m2-c.explanation: Xa i-lead ion ($\text{Pb}^{2+}$) ne-iodide ion ($\text{I}^-$) zisabela, kwenziwa i-precipitate etyheli ekhethekileyo nekhazimlayo, i-lead iodide ($\text{PbI}_2$).

chemistry-m2-q5.prompt: Xa amanzi enziwa nge-electrolysis ngokongezwa isixa esincinci se-electrolyte, nguwuphi ongqamanisa ngokuchanekileyo iigesi ezenziwa kwi-electrode (-) nakwi-electrode (+) nomlinganiselo wazo womthamo?

options.a: (-) electrode: hydrogen (H₂),  (+) electrode: oxygen (O₂),  umlinganiselo womthamo = 2 : 1
options.b: (-) electrode: oxygen (O₂),  (+) electrode: hydrogen (H₂),  umlinganiselo womthamo = 1 : 2
options.c: (-) electrode: hydrogen (H₂),  (+) electrode: chlorine (Cl₂),  umlinganiselo womthamo = 1 : 1
options.d: (-) electrode: umphunga wamanzi,  (+) electrode: nitrogen,  umlinganiselo womthamo = 2 : 1

hints: Ifomula yekhemikhali yamanzi yi-H₂O (iiathom ezi-2 ze-hydrogen kunye ne-athom e-1 ye-oxygen).
Ukulinganisa kwe-electrolysis: 2H₂O → 2H₂ + O₂
chemistry-m2-q5.explanation: Ngokolinganiso lwe-electrolysis yamanzi, $2\text{H}_2\text{O}(l) \rightarrow 2\text{H}_2(g) + \text{O}_2(g)$, igesi ye-hydrogen yenziwa kwi-electrode (-), apho kwenzeka ukuncitshiswa, kumthamo ongu-$2$, kwaye igesi ye-oxygen yenziwa kwi-electrode (+), apho kwenzeka i-oxidation, kumthamo ongu-$1$.

chemistry-m3-q1.prompt: Yintoni isizathu esisisiseko sokuba 'umthetho wokugcinwa kobunzima' ube yinyani xa kwenzeka utshintsho lwekhemikhali?
